name: ECG By Title
query:
SELECT
    si.patient AS "Patient:Data:120",
    si.patient_name AS "Patient Name:Data:250",
    si.ref_practitioner AS "Consultant:Data:220",
    si.posting_date AS "Date:Date:110",
    si.name AS "reff_invoice:Data:180",
    sii.net_amount AS "Amount:Currency:120",
    r.title AS "Title:Data:250",
    sii.item_code AS "Item Code:Data:150",
    1 AS "Qty:Int:60"
    
    FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
    ON sii.parent = si.name
LEFT JOIN `tabRadiology` r
    ON r.patient = si.patient
WHERE
    si.docstatus = 1
    AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    AND sii.item_group = 'ECG-ECHO'
    
ORDER BY
    si.posting_date DESC,
    si.name DESC;
